title: SKU
description: SKU canonical v1 contract for Product Master. A SKU can be complete or active without being sellable; sellable belongs to Operational Core.
$comment: Sources: PACK-02 sections on SKU canonical, identifier no-reuse, audit history, and Product Activation dependency. Lifecycle values are governed by enums/product/sku-lifecycle-status.yaml.

sku_code.description: Canonical SKU code such as A1/CS/DM/HS from the current 19 SKU operational catalog; the schema remains extensible.

public_name.description: Public product name for the SKU.

dietary_type.description: Dietary grouping from the operational SKU catalog: Vegan / Man. TODO: confirm exact English label for Man.

lifecycle_status.description: Closed SKU lifecycle enum governed by enums/product/sku-lifecycle-status.yaml.

formula_version_id.description: Linked current Formula Version, usually G1 for operational production.
